ESV.1: And I said: Hear, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel! Is it not for you to know justice? —
ESV.2: you who hate the good and love the evil, who tear the skin from off my people  and their flesh from off their bones,
ESV.3: who eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones in pieces and chop them up like meat in a pot, like flesh in a cauldron.
ESV.4: Then they will cry to the LORD, but he will not answer them; he will hide his face from them at that time, because they have made their deeds evil.
ESV.5: Thus says the LORD concerning the prophets who lead my people astray, who cry “Peace” when they have something to eat, but declare war against him who puts nothing into their mouths.
ESV.6: Therefore it shall be night to you, without vision, and darkness to you, without divination. The sun shall go down on the prophets, and the day shall be black over them;
ESV.7: the seers shall be disgraced, and the diviners put to shame; they shall all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.
ESV.8: But as for me, I am filled with power, with the Spirit of the LORD, and with justice and might, to declare to Jacob his transgression and to Israel his sin.
ESV.9: Hear this, you heads of the house of Jacob and rulers of the house of Israel, who detest justice and make crooked all that is straight,
ESV.10: who build Zion with blood and Jerusalem with iniquity.
ESV.11: Its heads give judgment for a bribe; its priests teach for a price; its prophets practice divination for money; yet they lean on the LORD and say, “Is not the LORD in the midst of us? No disaster shall come upon us.”
ESV.12: Therefore because of you Zion shall be plowed as a field; Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins, and the mountain of the house a wooded height.

NASB.1: And I said, 'Hear now, heads of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel. Is it not for you to know justice?
NASB.2: 'You who hate good and love evil, Who tear off their skin from them And their flesh from their bones,
NASB.3: Who eat the flesh of my people, Strip off their skin from them, Break their bones And chop [them] up as for the pot And as meat in a kettle.'
NASB.4: Then they will cry out to the LORD, But He will not answer them. Instead, He will hide His face from them at that time Because they have practiced evil deeds.
NASB.5: Thus says the LORD concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; When they have [something] to bite with their teeth, They cry, 'Peace,' But against him who puts nothing in their mouths They declare holy war.
NASB.6: Therefore [it will be] night for you-- without vision, And darkness for you-- without divination. The sun will go down on the prophets, And the day will become dark over them.
NASB.7: The seers will be ashamed And the diviners will be embarrassed. Indeed, they will all cover [their] mouths Because there is no answer from God.
NASB.8: On the other hand I am filled with power-- With the Spirit of the LORD-- And with justice and courage To make known to Jacob his rebellious act, Even to Israel his sin.
NASB.9: Now hear this, heads of the house of Jacob And rulers of the house of Israel, Who abhor justice And twist everything that is straight,
NASB.10: Who build Zion with bloodshed And Jerusalem with violent injustice.
NASB.11: Her leaders pronounce judgment for a bribe, Her priests instruct for a price And her prophets divine for money. Yet they lean on the LORD saying, 'Is not the LORD in our midst? Calamity will not come upon us.'
NASB.12: Therefore, on account of you Zion will be plowed as a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins, And the mountain of the temple [will become] high places of a forest.

AMP.1:
And I said,
"Hear now, heads of Jacob
And rulers of the house of Israel.
Is it not for you to know and administer justice?
AMP.2:
"You who hate good and love evil,
Who tear the skin off my people
And their flesh from their bones;
AMP.3:
You who eat the flesh of my people,
Strip off their skin from them,
Break their bones
And chop them in pieces as for the pot,
Like meat in a kettle."
AMP.4:
Then they will cry to the LORD,
But He will not answer them;
Instead, He will even hide His face from them at that time [withholding His mercy]
Because they have practiced and tolerated and ignored evil acts.
AMP.5:
Thus says the LORD concerning the [false] prophets who lead my people astray;
When they have something good to bite with their teeth,
They call out, "Peace,"
But against the one who gives them nothing to eat,
They declare a holy war.
AMP.6:
Therefore it will be night (tragedy) for you—without vision,
And darkness (cataclysm) for you—without foresight.
The sun shall go down on the [false] prophets,
And the day shall become dark and black over them.
AMP.7:
The seers shall be ashamed
And the diviners discredited and embarrassed;
Indeed, they shall all cover their mouths [in shame]
Because there is no answer from God.
AMP.8:
But in fact, I am filled with power,
With the Spirit of the LORD,
And with justice and might,
To declare to Jacob his transgression
And to Israel his sin.
AMP.9:
Now hear this, you heads of the house of Jacob
And rulers of the house of Israel,
Who hate and reject justice
And twist everything that is straight,
AMP.10:
Who build Zion with blood [and extortion and murder]
And Jerusalem with violent injustice.
AMP.11:
Her leaders pronounce judgment for a bribe,
Her priests teach for a fee,
And her prophets foretell for money;
Yet they lean on the LORD, saying,
"Is not the LORD among us?
No tragedy or distress will come on us."
AMP.12:
Therefore, on account of you
Zion shall be plowed like a field,
Jerusalem shall become a heap of ruins,
And the mountain of the house [of the LORD] shall become like a densely wooded hill.

NLT.1:
I said, “Listen, you leaders of Israel!
You are supposed to know right from wrong,
NLT.2:
but you are the very ones
who hate good and love evil.
You skin my people alive
and tear the flesh from their bones.
NLT.3:
Yes, you eat my people’s flesh,
strip off their skin,
and break their bones.
You chop them up
like meat for the cooking pot.
NLT.4:
Then you beg the LORD for help in times of trouble!
Do you really expect him to answer?
After all the evil you have done,
he won’t even look at you!”
NLT.5:
This is what the LORD says:
“You false prophets are leading my people astray!
You promise peace for those who give you food,
but you declare war on those who refuse to feed you.
NLT.6:
Now the night will close around you,
cutting off all your visions.
Darkness will cover you,
putting an end to your predictions.
The sun will set for you prophets,
and your day will come to an end.
NLT.7:
Then you seers will be put to shame,
and you fortune-tellers will be disgraced.
And you will cover your faces
because there is no answer from God.”
NLT.8:
But as for me, I am filled with power —
with the Spirit of the LORD.
I am filled with justice and strength
to boldly declare Israel’s sin and rebellion.
NLT.9:
Listen to me, you leaders of Israel!
You hate justice and twist all that is right.
NLT.10:
You are building Jerusalem
on a foundation of murder and corruption.
NLT.11:
You rulers make decisions based on bribes;
you priests teach God’s laws only for a price;
you prophets won’t prophesy unless you are paid.
Yet all of you claim to depend on the LORD.
“No harm can come to us,” you say,
“for the LORD is here among us.”
NLT.12:
Because of you, Mount Zion will be plowed like an open field;
Jerusalem will be reduced to ruins!
A thicket will grow on the heights
where the Temple now stands.

MSG.1:
Then I said:
"Listen, leaders of Jacob, leaders of Israel:
Don't you know anything of justice?
MSG.2:
Haters of good, lovers of evil:
Isn't justice in your job description?
But you skin my people alive.
You rip the meat off their bones.
MSG.3:
You break up the bones, chop the meat,
and throw it in a pot for cannibal stew."
MSG.4:
The time's coming, though, when these same leaders
will cry out for help to God, but he won't listen.
He'll turn his face the other way
because of their history of evil.
MSG.5:
Here is God's Message to the prophets,
the preachers who lie to my people:
"For as long as they're well paid and well fed,
the prophets preach, 'Isn't life wonderful! Peace to all!'
But if you don't pay up and jump on their bandwagon,
their 'God bless you' turns into 'God damn you.'
MSG.6:
Therefore, you're going blind. You'll see nothing.
You'll live in deep shadows and know nothing.
The sun has set on the prophets.
They've had their day; from now on it's night.
MSG.7:
Visionaries will be confused,
experts will be all mixed up.
They'll hide behind their reputations and make lame excuses
to cover up their God-ignorance."
MSG.8:
But me—I'm filled with God's power,
filled with God's Spirit of justice and strength,
Ready to confront Jacob's crime
and Israel's sin.
MSG.9:
The leaders of Jacob and
the leaders of Israel are
Leaders contemptuous of justice,
who twist and distort right living,
MSG.10:
Leaders who build Zion by killing people,
who expand Jerusalem by committing crimes.
MSG.11:
Judges sell verdicts to the highest bidder,
priests mass-market their teaching,
prophets preach for high fees,
All the while posturing and pretending
dependence on God:
"We've got God on our side.
He'll protect us from disaster."
MSG.12:
Because of people like you,
Zion will be turned back into farmland,
Jerusalem end up as a pile of rubble,
and instead of the Temple on the mountain,
a few scraggly scrub pines.

NET.1: I said, “Listen, you leaders of Jacob, you rulers of the nation of Israel! You ought to know what is just,
NET.2: yet you hate what is good, and love what is evil. You flay my people’s skin and rip the flesh from their bones.
NET.3: You devour my people’s flesh, strip off their skin, and crush their bones. You chop them up like flesh in a pot — like meat in a kettle.
NET.4: Someday these sinners will cry to the LORD for help, but he will not answer them. He will hide his face from them at that time, because they have done such wicked deeds.”
NET.5: This is what the LORD says: “The prophets who mislead my people are as good as dead. If someone gives them enough to eat, they offer an oracle of peace. But if someone does not give them food, they are ready to declare war on him.
NET.6: Therefore night will fall, and you will receive no visions; it will grow dark, and you will no longer be able to read the omens. The sun will set on these prophets, and the daylight will turn to darkness over their heads.
NET.7: The prophets will be ashamed; the omen readers will be humiliated. All of them will cover their mouths, for they will receive no divine oracles.”
NET.8: But I am full of the courage that the LORD’s Spirit gives, and have a strong commitment to justice. This enables me to confront Jacob with its rebellion, and Israel with its sin.
NET.9: Listen to this, you leaders of the family of Jacob, you rulers of the nation of Israel! You hate justice and pervert all that is right.
NET.10: You build Zion through bloody crimes, Jerusalem through unjust violence.
NET.11: Her leaders take bribes when they decide legal cases, her priests proclaim rulings for profit, and her prophets read omens for pay. Yet they claim to trust the LORD and say, “The LORD is among us. Disaster will not overtake us!”
NET.12: Therefore, because of you, Zion will be plowed up like a field, Jerusalem will become a heap of ruins, and the Temple Mount will become a hill overgrown with brush!
